issue.title: Use smart pointers for YBqlOp and YBPgsqlOp

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: This is an enhancement of an existing feature

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body: Instead of passing around raw pointers and managing `YBql*Op` and `YBPgsql*Op` manually which makes it easier to introduce memory leaks (e.g. see #3031), we should use smart pointers
